description: What is happening in production, by view: metrics, traces, errors (grouped), history (versions and events), timeline, impact (a version's effect), database (frequent and slow SQL queries), edge (what the CDN PoPs serve) or ask (dated facts around a question).

database.description: Database name; the first declared by default.

errors.description: Only the traces with a span in error.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of a group, for its detail.

min_duration.description: Only the traces longer than this, for example "500ms" or "2s".

operation.description: Only the traces of this operation (span name), for example "GET /orders".

query.description: A PromQL query (Prometheus' query language: https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/basics/); without it, traffic and errors.

service.description: The app's OTEL_SERVICE_NAME; by default, the project's name (what while sets).

since_minutes.description: Window, in minutes (30 days at most).

trace_id.description: One trace in detail: its id (32 hexadecimal characters).

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

url.description: An address of the environment: why a PoP keeps it or not.

version.description: Version number; the active version by default.

window_minutes.description: The compared window, before and after the version.

name: observe_app
title: Understand what is happening
